initialEarlyRestoreFailure.correction: Both restore-ledger reads use ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable -DateKind String. A real synthetic save/read roundtrip regression was added.

temporaryInstallConsent.scopeLimitation: The scopes are broader than the B app. Operations are pinned to the two approved users and existing broker app ID; no application permissions, tenant-wide grant, new app, SSO change or data-audience change is authorized.
temporaryInstallConsent.tokenCaveat: Removing consent does not revoke previously issued access tokens or sessions.
